audit.corrected: Public Execution is 130s: it suppresses, then stuns. Once the stun ends, your R re-cast dashes you clean out of it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks a non-existent ability called "Repeating Dashes" and assigns it the letter E. Ambessa has no such ability.
audit.why: Her dash chain is Drakehound's Step (P): entering an attack or movement command while casting causes her to dash once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage and attack speed. Her E is Lacerate (13/12/11/10/9). The tell is the empowered auto wind-up, not an ability cast — this is exactly the auto-reset burst tell flagged in _missing/akali.json.
audit.corrected: Drakehound's Step dashes her after every cast — the empowered auto is the tell, not the ability itself.
